phase_help.alignment: Registering all frames of a series onto a common pixel grid so each star keeps the same coordinates throughout the night.
phase_help.calibration: Removing the camera signature from raw frames with master darks and flats, plus sanity gates that catch a wrong or stale master.
phase_help.comp_selection: Choosing the ensemble of constant stars for differential photometry: color, brightness, distance, stability, isolation and coverage. Several limits adapt to field density.
phase_help.detection: Finding stars, solving sky coordinates (including the blind solver), building the masterstar catalog, matching Gaia, and classifying field density and variability.
phase_help.export: Output for the outside world: AAVSO/VarAstro submission and TESS cross-analysis.
phase_help.extinction: Correcting for the atmosphere: second-order extinction (k2) that depends on star color and airmass, and optional color-term handling.
phase_help.observer: Who observed and from where: AAVSO identity and observing-site coordinates. Observatory facts; the database LOCATION table is the source of truth.
phase_help.paths: Where VYVAR finds its data on disk: star catalogs, plate-solve indexes, the archive and the calibration library. Machine-specific plumbing - set once, then forget.
phase_help.photometry: Measuring star brightness: aperture sizing, sky annulus, error model, aperture correction, optional PSF photometry and detrending. The heart of the pipeline.
phase_help.qc: Automatic per-frame checks (sharpness, elongation, background, star counts) and optional gates that drop bad frames, plus the sky-surface preprocess.
phase_help.reports: What appears in the PDF summary report: the color HR diagram of the field, optional online enrichment (SIMBAD, Gaia), and its visual tuning.
phase_help.system: Machine-level behavior: parallel workers and RAM reserves. Computed from your hardware; override only when you must.
phase_help.trust: How VYVAR grades its own results: GREEN/YELLOW/RED trust of the comparison ensemble and check star, minimum epochs and frames, and light-curve quality thresholds.

aavso_filter_map.help: Optional mapping of your local filter names to official AAVSO filter codes used in exports (e.g. 'NoFilter' -> 'CV').
aavso_filter_map.label: AAVSO Filter Map

aavso_observer_code.help: Your official AAVSO observer code (e.g. UMIA). Stamped into every AAVSO export as #OBSCODE. A warning is emitted ONLY when this value is missing/empty; any explicitly configured code (including UMIA) is accepted with no placeholder warning.
aavso_observer_code.label: AAVSO Observer Code

alignment_detection_sigma.help: Detection sensitivity of the star finder used to pick alignment control stars.
alignment_detection_sigma.label: Alignment Detection Sigma

alignment_max_control_points.help: Maximum number of control points the aligner may use per frame; more is robuster but slower.
alignment_max_control_points.label: Alignment Max Control Points

alignment_max_stars.help: Cap on stars considered by the alignment matcher.
alignment_max_stars.label: Alignment Max Stars

annulus_inner_fwhm.help: Inner radius of the sky annulus in FWHM units; density adaptation may tighten it on dense fields.
annulus_inner_fwhm.label: Annulus Inner FWHM

annulus_outer_fwhm.help: Outer radius of the sky annulus in FWHM units.
annulus_outer_fwhm.label: Annulus Outer FWHM

aperture_comp_factor.help: Aperture size multiplier applied to comparison stars.
aperture_comp_factor.label: Aperture Comp Factor

aperture_correction_enabled.help: Enables aperture correction: transferring flux measured in a small aperture to the total-flux scale using bright reference stars.
aperture_correction_enabled.label: Aperture Correction Enabled

aperture_correction_max_contamination.help: Maximum neighbour contamination a reference star may have to be used for aperture correction.
aperture_correction_max_contamination.label: Aperture Correction Max Contamination

aperture_correction_max_scatter_mag.help: Maximum scatter (mag) allowed among aperture-correction reference stars.
aperture_correction_max_scatter_mag.label: Aperture Correction Max Scatter Mag

aperture_correction_min_ref_stars.help: Minimum reference stars required to compute an aperture correction.
aperture_correction_min_ref_stars.label: Aperture Correction Min Ref Stars

aperture_fwhm_factor.help: Base aperture radius in FWHM units; the SNR-optimal sizing sweep may adapt the effective radius per star.
aperture_fwhm_factor.label: Aperture FWHM Factor

aperture_photometry_enabled.help: Master switch of aperture photometry - the production measurement method of VYVAR.
aperture_photometry_enabled.label: Aperture Photometry Enabled

aperture_snr_sizing.help: SNR-optimal aperture sizing sweep bounds as FWHM multiples: 'small' is the minimum radius (best for faint stars), 'large' the maximum. WAVE-B merged the former aperture_fwhm_factor_small/_large scalars into this mapping (there is no medium class).
aperture_snr_sizing.label: Aperture SNR Sizing

aperture_variable_factor.help: Aperture size multiplier applied to the variable (target) star.
aperture_variable_factor.label: Aperture Variable Factor

apply_color_term.help: Whether a color-term transformation is applied to magnitudes ('off' keeps instrumental system).
apply_color_term.label: Apply Color Term

archive_root.help: Root folder of the observation archive (raw and processed drafts). Resolved per machine at startup.
archive_root.label: Archive Root

auto_fwhm_enabled.help: Automatically derives the frame-quality FWHM limit from the night's own seeing statistics instead of a fixed number.
auto_fwhm_enabled.label: Auto FWHM Enabled

auto_fwhm_k_factor.help: Multiplier applied to the night's median FWHM when deriving the automatic quality limit.
auto_fwhm_k_factor.label: Auto FWHM K Factor

auto_fwhm_k_max.help: Upper clamp of the automatic FWHM limit multiplier.
auto_fwhm_k_max.label: Auto FWHM K Max

auto_fwhm_k_min.help: Lower clamp of the automatic FWHM limit multiplier.
auto_fwhm_k_min.label: Auto FWHM K Min

blind_img_select_mode.help: Strategy for picking which detected stars feed the blind solver ('per_cell' spreads them evenly across the frame).
blind_img_select_mode.label: Blind Img Select Mode

blind_img_star_budget.help: Maximum number of image stars handed to the blind solver; a budget keeps solving fast.
blind_img_star_budget.label: Blind Img Star Budget

blind_index_fine_path.help: Path to the fine-scale astrometric index used by the blind plate solver for narrow-field rigs.
blind_index_fine_path.label: Blind Index Fine Path

blind_index_path.help: Legacy single-index path for the blind solver; superseded by the fine/wide pair with automatic selection.
blind_index_path.label: Blind Index Path

blind_index_select_mode.help: How the blind solver picks its index: 'auto' chooses fine or wide by the rig's field of view; can be forced manually.
blind_index_select_mode.label: Blind Index Select Mode

blind_index_wide_path.help: Path to the wide-field astrometric index used by the blind plate solver for wide rigs (e.g. the 200mm Zeiss).
blind_index_wide_path.label: Blind Index Wide Path

blind_use_rig_prior.help: Uses the known rig plate scale as a prior to reject implausible blind-solve candidates early.
blind_use_rig_prior.label: Blind Use Rig Prior

blind_verify_early_accept.help: Number of verified star matches at which the blind solver stops early and accepts the solution.
blind_verify_early_accept.label: Blind Verify Early Accept

blind_verify_early_floor.help: Minimum matches required before early acceptance may trigger at all.
blind_verify_early_floor.label: Blind Verify Early Floor

blind_verify_early_fraction.help: Fraction of catalog stars that must match for early acceptance.
blind_verify_early_fraction.label: Blind Verify Early Fraction

blind_verify_enabled.help: Verifies every blind-solve candidate against the Gaia catalog before trusting it - the safety net of blind solving.
blind_verify_enabled.label: Blind Verify Enabled

blind_verify_inmemory_catalog.help: Keeps the verification catalog in memory for speed instead of re-querying the database.
blind_verify_inmemory_catalog.label: Blind Verify Inmemory Catalog

blind_verify_match_tol_px.help: Pixel tolerance when matching image stars to catalog positions during verification.
blind_verify_match_tol_px.label: Blind Verify Match Tol PX

blind_verify_min_fraction.help: Minimum fraction of stars that must match for a blind solution to pass verification.
blind_verify_min_fraction.label: Blind Verify Min Fraction

blind_verify_min_matches.help: Absolute minimum of matched stars for a verified blind solution.
blind_verify_min_matches.label: Blind Verify Min Matches

blind_verify_top_n.help: How many best blind candidates get the full verification treatment.
blind_verify_top_n.label: Blind Verify Top N

bpm_dark_mad_sigma.help: Sensitivity of bad-pixel detection on the master dark: pixels deviating more than this many robust sigmas are mapped as defective.
bpm_dark_mad_sigma.label: Bpm Dark Mad Sigma

cal_diag_autocorrect_enabled.help: Lets the calibration diagnostic auto-correct a detected master-dark convention mismatch (e.g. SUM vs MEAN stacking) instead of aborting.
cal_diag_autocorrect_enabled.label: Cal Diag Autocorrect Enabled

cal_diag_gate_enabled.help: Master switch of the calibration diagnostic gate: sanity-checks the sky level after dark subtraction and fails closed on nonsense.
cal_diag_gate_enabled.label: Cal Diag Gate Enabled

cal_diag_hard_sigma.help: Hard limit (in sigmas) of the post-calibration sky sanity check; beyond it the frame set is rejected.
cal_diag_hard_sigma.label: Cal Diag Hard Sigma

cal_diag_rel_tol.help: Relative tolerance of the pre-subtraction dark-vs-frame level cross-check (2% by default).
cal_diag_rel_tol.label: Cal Diag Rel Tol

cal_diag_sat_warn_frac.help: Fraction of the saturation limit at which the diagnostic starts warning about a too-bright master or frame.
cal_diag_sat_warn_frac.label: Cal Diag Sat Warn Frac

calibration_library_native_binning.help: Binning in which the calibration library masters were built; masters get resampled (with provenance flag) when a draft uses another binning.
calibration_library_native_binning.label: Calibration Library Native Binning

calibration_library_root.help: Root folder of the calibration library (master darks/flats organized by camera, binning and temperature). Resolved per machine.
calibration_library_root.label: Calibration Library Root

calibration_master_ccd_temp_tolerance_c.help: Maximum allowed CCD temperature difference (deg C) between a master dark and the light frames it calibrates.
calibration_master_ccd_temp_tolerance_c.label: Calibration Master CCD TEMP Tolerance C

catalog_query_max_rows.help: Cap on rows returned by a single Gaia catalog query; protects memory on very dense fields.
catalog_query_max_rows.label: Catalog Query Max Rows

check_select_rms_floor.help: RMS floor in check-star selection scoring.
check_select_rms_floor.label: Check Select RMS Floor

check_star_min_epochs.help: Minimum epochs the check star must cover for its quality verdict to count.
check_star_min_epochs.label: Check Star Min Epochs

cog_ac_factor_max.help: Upper clamp of the curve-of-growth aperture-correction factor.
cog_ac_factor_max.label: COG Ac Factor Max

cog_aperture_correction_enabled.help: Enables the curve-of-growth variant of aperture correction (experimental alternative).
cog_aperture_correction_enabled.label: COG Aperture Correction Enabled

cog_isolation_fwhm.help: Isolation radius (FWHM) a star needs to serve as a curve-of-growth reference.
cog_isolation_fwhm.label: COG Isolation FWHM

cog_ladder_step_px.help: Radius step (px) of the curve-of-growth aperture ladder.
cog_ladder_step_px.label: COG Ladder Step PX

cog_min_stars.help: Minimum stars needed to fit a curve of growth.
cog_min_stars.label: COG Min Stars

cog_ref_fwhm.help: Reference FWHM used to normalize the curve of growth.
cog_ref_fwhm.label: COG Ref FWHM

cog_sat_frac.help: Saturation-fraction cutoff for curve-of-growth reference stars.
cog_sat_frac.label: COG Sat Frac

cog_snr_min.help: Minimum SNR of a curve-of-growth reference star.
cog_snr_min.label: COG SNR Min

comp_clip_sigma.help: Sigma-clipping level applied to comparison-star series before ensemble statistics.
comp_clip_sigma.label: Comp Clip Sigma

comp_color_tiers.help: Ordered color-match tiers for comparison weighting. Each entry is a BP-RP color-match limit ('bprp', tighter = better color match) and the ensemble weight ('w') for stars in that tier. WAVE-B merged the eight comp_tier{1..4}_bprp_limit / _weight scalars into this list of dicts.
comp_color_tiers.label: Comp Color Tiers

comp_contamination_penalty_k.help: Weight penalty strength for contaminated comparison stars in ensemble weighting.
comp_contamination_penalty_k.label: Comp Contamination Penalty K

comp_iterative_clip_enabled.help: Iterative re-clipping of the comparison ensemble (drop-and-reweigh loop); ON in production since the Brno fix of 2026-06-14.
comp_iterative_clip_enabled.label: Comp Iterative Clip Enabled

comp_max_delta_bprp.help: Maximum Gaia BP-RP color difference between a comparison star and the target - the primary defense against extinction systematics on unfiltered data; density adaptation adjusts it.
comp_max_delta_bprp.label: Comp Max Delta BPRP

comp_max_slope_mmag_hr.help: Maximum linear trend (mmag/hour) a comparison star may show before being rejected as drifting.
comp_max_slope_mmag_hr.label: Comp Max Slope Mmag Hr

comp_qa_enabled.help: Per-epoch quality assessment of the comparison ensemble feeding the trust verdict.
comp_qa_enabled.label: Comp Qa Enabled

comp_select_rms_floor.help: Numerical floor of comparison RMS in weighting (prevents division blow-ups).
comp_select_rms_floor.label: Comp Select RMS Floor

comp_slope_significance_k.help: Statistical significance required before a comparison star's trend counts as real drift.
comp_slope_significance_k.label: Comp Slope Significance K

comp_sparse_fallback_enabled.help: Allows the sparse-field fallback path when strict criteria yield too few comparisons.
comp_sparse_fallback_enabled.label: Comp Sparse Fallback Enabled

comp_sparse_fallback_min.help: Minimum comparisons the sparse fallback aims for (0 = take what exists).
comp_sparse_fallback_min.label: Comp Sparse Fallback Min

comp_trust_min_comps.help: GREEN trust threshold of ensemble size (default 5 per literature; production runs 3 with sigma scaled by N - see DECISIONS). Fewer comps degrade to YELLOW, not RED.
comp_trust_min_comps.label: Comp Trust Min Comps

crowding_blend_tighten_threshold.help: Blend-fraction level above which the (experimental) crowding classifier would tighten comparison criteria.
crowding_blend_tighten_threshold.label: Crowding Blend Tighten Threshold

crowding_classifier_enabled.help: Experimental crowding classifier switch; OFF pending validation on Newton dense-field data.
crowding_classifier_enabled.label: Crowding Classifier Enabled

crowding_comp_availability_loosen_count.help: Comparison-star availability level treated as plentiful when the crowding logic decides about loosening.
crowding_comp_availability_loosen_count.label: Crowding Comp Availability Loosen Count

crowding_tighten_min_fwhm_px.help: Minimum FWHM (px) below which crowding-driven tightening is not applied (undersampled images).
crowding_tighten_min_fwhm_px.label: Crowding Tighten Min FWHM PX

dao_qc_in_calibrate.help: Runs the star-detection based QC directly during calibration so bad frames are flagged as early as possible.
dao_qc_in_calibrate.label: DAO QC In Calibrate

database_path.help: Path to the main VYVAR SQLite database (drafts, equipment, locations, results). Resolved per machine.
database_path.label: Database Path

debug_platesolver.help: Verbose diagnostic logging of the plate solver; for troubleshooting only.
debug_platesolver.label: Debug Platesolver

democratic_detrend_enabled.help: Optional 'democratic' detrend of the light curve (median trend of the field); OFF by default - detrending can eat real variability.
democratic_detrend_enabled.label: Democratic Detrend Enabled

democratic_sg_window_frac.help: Window width (fraction of the night) of the democratic detrend smoother.
democratic_sg_window_frac.label: Democratic SG Window Frac

epsf_min_stars.help: Minimum suitable stars required to build an empirical PSF model (ePSF) for PSF photometry.
epsf_min_stars.label: EPSF Min Stars

err_background_mode.help: How the background-noise term of the error model is estimated ('empirical' = measured from empty apertures on the frame).
err_background_mode.label: Err Background Mode

err_empty_apertures_min.help: Minimum empty apertures required for a valid empirical background estimate.
err_empty_apertures_min.label: Err Empty Apertures Min

err_empty_apertures_n.help: How many empty apertures are placed per frame for the empirical background noise measurement.
err_empty_apertures_n.label: Err Empty Apertures N

exoplanet_local_db_path.help: Path to the local NASA Exoplanet Archive database used to cross-match detected stars with known exoplanet hosts.
exoplanet_local_db_path.label: Exoplanet Local Db Path

exoplanet_match_max_sep_arcsec.help: Maximum sky separation (arcsec) for identifying a detected star with a known exoplanet host.
exoplanet_match_max_sep_arcsec.label: Exoplanet Match Max Sep Arcsec

export_arcsec_per_px.help: Plate-scale label written into export metadata; the science value comes from the WCS. WAVE-B removed its config.json fallback (derivable from WCS/optics).
export_arcsec_per_px.label: Export Arcsec Per PX

field_density_adaptive_enabled.help: Master switch of density adaptation: sparse/normal/dense field profiles automatically loosen or tighten comparison-star criteria.
field_density_adaptive_enabled.label: Field Density Adaptive Enabled

field_density_dense_threshold.help: Matched-star count above which the field is treated as dense (tighter criteria).
field_density_dense_threshold.label: Field Density Dense Threshold

field_density_sparse_threshold.help: Matched-star count below which the field is treated as sparse (looser criteria so an ensemble can still be formed).
field_density_sparse_threshold.label: Field Density Sparse Threshold

frame_align_residual_gate_enabled.help: Optional gate dropping frames whose alignment residuals are unusually large (poorly registered frames).
frame_align_residual_gate_enabled.label: Frame Align Residual Gate Enabled

frame_align_residual_max_frac.help: Maximum fraction of frames the alignment-residual gate may drop; protects against discarding the night.
frame_align_residual_max_frac.label: Frame Align Residual Max Frac

frame_align_residual_min_keep_frames.help: Minimum number of frames that must survive the alignment-residual gate.
frame_align_residual_min_keep_frames.label: Frame Align Residual Min Keep Frames

frame_height_px.help: Frame height in pixels; measured from FITS NAXIS2 at run time. WAVE-B internalized it (no longer stored in config.json).
frame_height_px.label: Frame Height PX

frame_quality_fwhm_factor.help: Scaling of the FWHM threshold used by the frame-quality gate.
frame_quality_fwhm_factor.label: Frame Quality FWHM Factor

frame_quality_gate_enabled.help: Optional gate excluding frames of clearly worse sharpness than the night's typical seeing.
frame_quality_gate_enabled.label: Frame Quality Gate Enabled

frame_quality_min_keep_frames.help: Minimum number of frames that must survive the frame-quality gate.
frame_quality_min_keep_frames.label: Frame Quality Min Keep Frames

frame_quality_ratio_k.help: How many times worse than the typical frame a frame must be before the quality gate drops it.
frame_quality_ratio_k.label: Frame Quality Ratio K

frame_width_px.help: Frame width in pixels; measured from FITS NAXIS1 at run time. WAVE-B internalized it (no longer stored in config.json).
frame_width_px.label: Frame Width PX

gaia_db_path.help: Path to the local full-sky Gaia DR3 SQLite database (40M+ stars) used for star identification and comparison selection.
gaia_db_path.label: Gaia Db Path

gain.help: Detector gain (e-/ADU) converting counts to electrons in the error model; resolved from the FITS header (cross-checked against the DB). WAVE-B removed its config.json fallback - the resolver is authoritative.
gain.label: Gain

global_comp_pool_enabled.help: Builds one field-wide comparison pool reused across targets instead of fully per-target pools.
global_comp_pool_enabled.label: Global Comp Pool Enabled

gs11_comp_max_dilution.help: Maximum dilution (flux contamination) a comparison star may have under the GS11 dilution model.
gs11_comp_max_dilution.label: GS11 Comp Max Dilution

gs11_comp_suspect_dilution.help: Dilution level at which a comparison star is marked suspect.
gs11_comp_suspect_dilution.label: GS11 Comp Suspect Dilution

gs11_dilution_aperture_arcsec.help: Aperture (arcsec) used when computing catalog-based dilution; 0 derives it from the photometric aperture.
gs11_dilution_aperture_arcsec.label: GS11 Dilution Aperture Arcsec

gs11_dilution_enabled.help: Enables catalog-based dilution estimation (how much neighbour light leaks into apertures).
gs11_dilution_enabled.label: GS11 Dilution Enabled

gs11_dilution_mag_limit_delta.help: How many magnitudes fainter than the star the dilution census still counts neighbours.
gs11_dilution_mag_limit_delta.label: GS11 Dilution Mag Limit Delta

gs11_target_min_dilution.help: Minimum acceptable target dilution before the target is flagged as badly blended.
gs11_target_min_dilution.label: GS11 Target Min Dilution

hrd_color_bg_box_px.help: Background sampling box (px) for star colors in the color HR diagram.
hrd_color_bg_box_px.label: HRD Color Bg Box PX

hrd_color_chroma_boost.help: Chroma amplification of the HRD star colors for visual clarity.
hrd_color_chroma_boost.label: HRD Color Chroma Boost

hrd_color_chroma_snr.help: Minimum color SNR before a star gets a saturated color in the HRD.
hrd_color_chroma_snr.label: HRD Color Chroma SNR

hrd_color_field_enabled.help: Renders the color HR diagram of the observed field in the report.
hrd_color_field_enabled.label: HRD Color Field Enabled

hrd_color_highlight_mode.help: Highlight style of interesting objects in the HRD ('soft' = gentle emphasis).
hrd_color_highlight_mode.label: HRD Color Highlight Mode

hrd_color_saturation.help: Base color saturation of HRD points.
hrd_color_saturation.label: HRD Color Saturation

hrd_color_white_point.help: White-point reference of HRD colors ('field_median' balances to the field's median color).
hrd_color_white_point.label: HRD Color White Point

hrd_dsc_confirm_prob.help: Probability threshold for confirming a candidate's HRD-based classification.
hrd_dsc_confirm_prob.label: HRD DSC Confirm Prob

hrd_enrich_max_candidates.help: Cap on objects sent to online enrichment services per report.
hrd_enrich_max_candidates.label: HRD Enrich Max Candidates

hrd_enrich_tap_timeout_s.help: Timeout (s) of TAP queries during online enrichment.
hrd_enrich_tap_timeout_s.label: HRD Enrich Tap Timeout S

hrd_max_per_category.help: Maximum highlighted objects per category in the HRD legend.
hrd_max_per_category.label: HRD Max Per Category

hrd_min_per_net.help: Minimum objects kept per detection net when trimming HRD highlights.
hrd_min_per_net.label: HRD Min Per Net

hrd_nss_category_enabled.help: Adds the Gaia non-single-star category to HRD highlights.
hrd_nss_category_enabled.label: HRD NSS Category Enabled

hrd_online_enrich_enabled.help: Online enrichment of interesting HRD objects from Gaia archive services.
hrd_online_enrich_enabled.label: HRD Online Enrich Enabled

hrd_parallax_min_mas.help: Minimum parallax (mas) for placing a star in the absolute-magnitude HRD.
hrd_parallax_min_mas.label: HRD Parallax Min Mas

hrd_parallax_snr_min.help: Minimum parallax SNR for a trustworthy HRD position.
hrd_parallax_snr_min.label: HRD Parallax SNR Min

hrd_simbad_enrich_enabled.help: SIMBAD lookups for object types of HRD highlights.
hrd_simbad_enrich_enabled.label: HRD Simbad Enrich Enabled

k2_ceiling.help: Upper cap of the fitted second-order extinction coefficient k2 (mag per airmass per color unit).
k2_ceiling.label: K2 Ceiling

k2_defaults_bprp.help: Per-band literature defaults of k2 keyed by BP-RP, used when fitting is off or fails.
k2_defaults_bprp.label: K2 Defaults BPRP

k2_fit_consistency_sigma.help: Consistency requirement (sigma) between the fitted k2 and expectations before the fit is trusted.
k2_fit_consistency_sigma.label: K2 Fit Consistency Sigma

k2_fit_enabled.help: Enables per-night fitting of the second-order extinction coefficient (v2 NIGHT_FIT; OFF until validated).
k2_fit_enabled.label: K2 Fit Enabled

k2_fit_lit_factor.help: Allowed multiple of the literature k2 value; fits outside it are rejected as unphysical.
k2_fit_lit_factor.label: K2 Fit Lit Factor

k2_fit_min_detectability.help: Minimum detectability (signal strength) the night must offer for a k2 fit to be attempted.
k2_fit_min_detectability.label: K2 Fit Min Detectability

k2_mode.help: Source of k2: 'literature' (defaults) or fitted per night when the fit program is enabled.
k2_mode.label: K2 Mode

lc_quality_min_frames.help: Minimum frames for a full-quality light-curve verdict.
lc_quality_min_frames.label: Lc Quality Min Frames

lc_quality_min_normal_frac.help: Minimum fraction of normal (unflagged) points a light curve needs.
lc_quality_min_normal_frac.label: Lc Quality Min Normal Frac

lc_quality_short_min_frames.help: Frame floor of the short-baseline quality track for brief series.
lc_quality_short_min_frames.label: Lc Quality Short Min Frames

masterdark_validity_days.help: How many days a master dark stays valid; older masters trigger a warning to shoot new darks (currently ~21.7. deadline).
masterdark_validity_days.label: Masterdark Validity Days

masterflat_validity_days.help: How many days a master flat stays valid before VYVAR asks for a fresh one.
masterflat_validity_days.label: Masterflat Validity Days

masterstar_accept_mode.help: Acceptance strategy of the masterstar plate solution ('odds' = statistical odds-ratio test).
masterstar_accept_mode.label: Masterstar Accept Mode

masterstar_best_of_n.label: Masterstar Best Of N

masterstar_catalog_recovery_min.help: Minimum fraction of catalog stars the masterstar must recover for the solution to be trusted.
masterstar_catalog_recovery_min.label: Masterstar Catalog Recovery Min

masterstar_centre_rms_max_px.help: Maximum RMS (px) of star positions near the frame centre for an acceptable astrometric solution.
masterstar_centre_rms_max_px.label: Masterstar Centre RMS Max PX

masterstar_dao_pass2_sigma.help: Detection sigma of the second, deeper DAO pass on the masterstar stack.
masterstar_dao_pass2_sigma.label: Masterstar DAO Pass2 Sigma

masterstar_dao_threshold_sigma.help: Primary DAO detection threshold (sigma) on the masterstar; lower finds fainter stars but more noise.
masterstar_dao_threshold_sigma.label: Masterstar DAO Threshold Sigma

masterstar_detection_cap_adaptive.help: Adapts the detection cap to field density instead of a fixed count.
masterstar_detection_cap_adaptive.label: Masterstar Detection Cap Adaptive

masterstar_detection_cap_k.help: Scaling constant of the adaptive detection cap.
masterstar_detection_cap_k.label: Masterstar Detection Cap K

masterstar_detection_cap_max.help: Upper clamp of the adaptive detection cap.
masterstar_detection_cap_max.label: Masterstar Detection Cap Max

masterstar_detection_cap_min.help: Lower clamp of the adaptive detection cap.
masterstar_detection_cap_min.label: Masterstar Detection Cap Min

masterstar_distortion_benign_ratio_max.help: Limit on the edge-to-centre distortion ratio still considered benign for the optics.
masterstar_distortion_benign_ratio_max.label: Masterstar Distortion Benign Ratio Max

masterstar_min_matched_floor.help: Absolute floor of matched stars a masterstar solution must reach.
masterstar_min_matched_floor.label: Masterstar Min Matched Floor

masterstar_platesolve_sip_max_order.help: Highest SIP distortion polynomial order the solver may fit.

vsx_local_db_path.label: VSX Local Db Path

vsx_out_of_scope_types.help: List of VSX variability types to leave unmeasured (default empty = feature inactive). Matching: a target's VSX type string is tokenized on the separators |, /, + and whitespace; each token is uppercased and a trailing : (VSX uncertain-classification mark) is stripped; config entries are normalized the same way; a target is OUT OF SCOPE when ANY of its tokens equals ANY configured entry. Substring matching is NEVER used (e.g. M does not exclude SRM). Applies ONLY to VSX auto-selected targets; manually added targets are never filtered. Matched targets stay in active_targets.csv with skip_photometry=True and skip_reason=vsx_type_out_of_scope (mask-first). Out-of-scope stars remain known variables and stay purged from the comparison pool. Example: ["ROT"] excludes ROT and ROT: but keeps DSCT|GDOR|SXPHE.
vsx_out_of_scope_types.label: VSX Out Of Scope Types
